author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! I was working on self hosting and throughout the last three months when sourcing parts it's truly insane to see the rise in components in the span of less than just three months. Building a homelab is getting into prices that rival decent cars and all we can hope is sometime it all comes tumbling back down. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: I Don't Know What To Do...
